ὄφειλον: ὀφείλω — owe; impf. 3 pl. act. (= Attic ὤφειλον), unaugmented: ’they owed’
ὑβρίζοντες: ὑβρίζω — treat insolently, behave outrageously; pres. part. act. masc. nom. pl., + acc.: ’insulting’
ὑπέρτερός: ὑπέρτερος — higher, superior; comparative adj., masc. nom. sg., accented before the enclitic ἐστιν
ὑπειροχίδην: Ὑπειροχίδης — son of Hypeirochus; patronymic, masc. acc. sg.
ὑπερέσχεθε: ὑπερέχω — hold over; aor. 3 sg. act. ὑπερέσχεθε, epic 2nd aor. (= Attic ὑπέρσχε), + gen.: ’held itself above’
ὑπερηφανέοντες: ὑπερηφανέω — behave overbearingly, be arrogant; pres. part. act. masc. nom. pl., epic uncontracted (= Attic ὑπερηφανοῦντες)
ὑπερμενεῖ: ὑπερμενής — exceedingly strong, mighty; adj., masc. dat. sg., epithet of Zeus
ὑποθέσθαι: ὑποτίθεμαι — suggest, advise; aor. inf. mid., 2nd aor.: ’to advise’
ὑπῆσαν: ὕπειμι — be under, be beneath; impf. 3 pl. (= Attic ὑπῆσαν): ’were under’
ὠλενίης: Ὠλένιος — Olenian, of Olenus; adj., fem. gen. sg., epic -ης (= Attic -ας), agreeing with πέτρης
ὤσαισθε: ὠθέω — push; mid. push back; aor. opt. mid. 2 pl., with κε in a potential: ’you could push back’
ῥόον: ῥόος — stream, flow; masc. acc. sg., epic uncontracted (= Attic ῥοῦς): ’stream’
ῥύσι: ῥύσιον — pledge, reprisal; neut. acc. pl., elided (ῥύσι’ = ῥύσια): ’goods taken in reprisal’
θέρωνται: θέρομαι — warm oneself, be heated; pres. subj. mid. 3 pl., long-vowel subj. in a clause after εἰς ὅ κε

__broaden__.βίῃ: βίη — strength, force; fem. dat. sg. used adverbially: ’by force’ · also dat. sg. in a periphrasis: βίῃ Ἡρακληείῃ ’by the might of Heracles’ (= Heracles) · also dat. sg. of means: ’by (your) strength’ · dat. sg. of respect: ’in might’ (βίῃ δ’ ὅ γε πολλὸν ἀμείνων ’in might he is much better’)
__broaden__.κ: κε(ν) (elided κ’) — epic particle marking a conditioned or potential action (= Attic ἄν) · also εἰ … κ’ + subj. in a condition: ’if … should’ · also ἐπεί κ’ + aor. subj., prospective temporal: ’when, once’
__broaden__.κατ: κατά (elided κατ’) — down from, down along; + gen./acc.; also a preverb in tmesis (κατ’ … ἕζετο = καθέζετο ’sat down’) · also κατ’ ἔμ’ αὐτόν ’by myself, alone’ (κατά + acc.) · also κατ’ αἶσαν ’according to due measure, rightly’ (κατά + acc.) · also + acc., ’upon, against’ (κατ’ ἀσπίδα ’on the shield’) · also + acc., ’over’ (κατ’ ὄσσε ’over the eyes’) · also + acc., ’throughout’ (κατ’ Ἀχαιΐδα ’throughout Achaea’)
__broaden__.μάχεσθαι: μάχομαι — fight (epic μαχέομαι); pres. inf. (Attic μάχεσθαι), + dat. ’fight against’ · also with ἀμφί + dat. of the cause: ’fight over’ (ἀμφ’ Ἑλένῃ … μάχεσθαι ’to fight over Helen’) · also pres. inf. as an imperative: ’fight!’ (μάχεσθαι ἐνὶ πρώτοισι) · also pres. inf. in an indirect alternative question: ’whether to fight’ (ἢ φευγέμεν ἠὲ μάχεσθαι ’whether to flee or to fight’) · also pres. inf., complementary after ἀριστεύεσκε: ’(be best) at fighting’ (ὃς ἀριστεύεσκε μάχεσθαι ’who used to excel in fighting’)
__broaden__.παῖδ: παῖς — child, daughter, son; fem. acc. sg., elided (παῖδ’ = παῖδα): ’child, daughter’ (παῖς is common gender) · also masc. acc. sg., elided: ’boy, son’ (παῖδ’ ὀρφανικόν ’the boy an orphan’) · also masc. acc. dual, elided (παῖδ’ = παῖδε): ’(two) boys’ (Μολίονε παῖδ’ ’the two Molions, boys’)
__broaden__.πρεσβυτάτην: πρέσβυς — old; superl. πρεσβύτατος ’eldest’; fem. acc. sg., predicative with με · also fem. acc. sg., agreeing with θύγατρ’: ’eldest’ (πρεσβυτάτην … θύγατρ’ ’eldest daughter’)
__broaden__.τύχε: τυγχάνω — hit upon, come upon (+ gen.); aor. 3 sg., strong aor. unaugmented (= ἔτυχε): ’had come down on’ · also aor. 3 sg. of things that befall, + dat.: ’fell to’ (μοι τύχε πολλά ’many things fell to me’)
__broaden__.ἑταίρου: ἑταῖρος — companion, comrade; masc. gen. sg., of cause with ἀχνύμενος: ’for the comrade’ · also masc. gen. sg., dependent on a noun: ’of a companion’ (παραίφασις ἑταίρου ’a companion’s persuasion’)
__broaden__.χειρὸς: χείρ — hand; fem. gen. sg.; χειρὸς ἑλόντε ’taking by the hand’ (gen. of the part seized) · also fem. gen. sg. of separation, with ἀπό in tmesis: ’from the hand’ (ἀπ’ … χειρὸς ὀμόργνυ) · also fem. gen. sg. of separation, with ἐκ in tmesis: ’out of the hand’ (ἐκ … χειρὸς σπάσσατο ’wrenched out of the hand’) · also fem. gen. sg. of separation after ἀπό: ’from the hand’ (ἐμῆς ἀπὸ χειρὸς ’from my hand’)
__broaden__.τίς: τίς, τί — who? what?; interrog. pron., masc./fem. nom. sg. · also indefinite τις after ὅς, written τίς: ’anyone, someone’ (ὅς τίς σφιν … ἡγήσαιτο ’anyone to lead them’) · also indefinite, written τίς: ’someone, one’ (ὡς δ’ ὅτε τίς τε δράκοντα ἰδών ’as when someone, seeing a snake’) · also indefinite τίς with a negative: ’no one’ (οὐ γάρ τίς … ἀνήρ ’for no man’) · also indefinite τις after μή, written τίς before the enclitic τοι: ’lest someone’ (μή τίς τοι … πήξῃ ’lest someone fix … in you’) · also indefinite τίς with a noun in a question after ἦ: ’some’ (ἦ τίς … θεός ’or some god’) · also indefinite τίς after μή, before the enclitic οἱ: ’lest anyone’ (μή τίς οἱ … κίοι ’lest anyone go off’)
